goal: 为研友制定合理的备考策略

n1.speaker: 研友 Zhao Lin
n1.line: I have only four months left before the exam, and my current schedule is a mess, so I really need a study strategy that is both realistic and effective.
n1.lineCn: 离考试只剩四个月了,我现在的安排一团糟,所以我真的需要一个既现实又有效的备考策略。

grammar.name: so 结果从句 + that 定语从句
grammar.note: so 连接因果,strategy that is both realistic and effective 中 that 引导定语从句,both...and... 并列结构,是常见的口语化长句。

options.text: Before designing anything, let us first map out your actual situation: how many hours can you study per day, and which subjects cost you the most time?
options.textCn: 在制定任何计划之前,我们先摸清你的真实情况:每天能学几个小时,哪科最耗时?
options.feedback: 先诊断后开方,基于数据制定策略,这是科学备考的第一步。

options.text: Just study eighteen hours a day and drink a lot of coffee. That is what all successful candidates do.
options.textCn: 每天学十八个小时,多喝咖啡就行,上岸的人都这样。
options.feedback: 迷信极端努力而忽视科学方法,四个月的高强度透支反而会导致崩溃。

options.text: You should buy the most expensive course package, because money spent is directly proportional to exam scores.
options.textCn: 你应该买最贵的课程套餐,花钱和学习成绩是成正比的。
options.feedback: 把成绩等同于消费金额,既不理性也不经济。

n2.speaker: 研友 Zhao Lin
n2.line: I can manage about six hours on weekdays and eight on weekends. English reading is my weakest point, taking me almost two hours to finish a single passage with full understanding.
n2.lineCn: 工作日我能学六小时,周末八小时。英语阅读是我最弱的点,完整读懂一篇要花差不多两小时。

grammar.name: 现在分词作伴随状语
grammar.note: taking me almost two hours to finish 是现在分词短语作伴随状语,补充说明阅读耗时,体现了分词替换并列句的高级表达。

options.text: Then let us set a concrete goal: finish two reading passages daily with time tracking, starting at sixty minutes each and gradually reducing to forty, while reviewing your wrong answers every Sunday.
options.textCn: 那我们定个具体目标:每天两篇阅读并计时,从每篇六十分钟逐步减到四十分钟,同时每周日复盘错题。
options.feedback: 目标量化、过程可测、附带复盘机制,是可行的渐进式提升方案。

options.text: Then you should simply give up on English and pour all your time into your best subject, so that your total score stays high.
options.textCn: 那你干脆放弃英语,把时间全砸到最擅长的科目上,保证总分高。
options.feedback: 考研单科有国家线,放弃英语等于直接出局,策略方向完全错误。

options.text: Then you should memorize the entire dictionary, because that is what it takes to read fast.
options.textCn: 那你应该背整本词典,读得快就得这样。
options.feedback: 背整本词典投入产出比极低,与四个月的备考周期严重不匹配。

n3.speaker: 研友 Zhao Lin
n3.line: I have tried that kind of advice before, and it never worked, because my energy collapsed within two weeks and I ended up falling even further behind.
n3.lineCn: 那种建议我以前试过,从没奏效,因为两周内我的精力就崩了,反而落后得更多。

grammar.name: because 原因从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.note: because 引导原因状语从句,从句内 energy collapsed 与 fell behind 并列,前文含宾语从句 that kind of advice,表达亲身教训。

options.text: You are right, and that is exactly why we should plan around sustainability: fixed study blocks, weekly rest, and measurable checkpoints instead of heroic effort.
options.textCn: 你说得对,这正是我们该围绕可持续性来规划的原因:固定学习时段、每周休息、可衡量的检查点,而不是拼意志力。
options.feedback: 从失败经验中提炼出可持续原则,备考策略回归科学与理性。

options.text: But if I do not push myself to the limit, how can I compete with candidates who study every waking hour?
options.textCn: 但如果我不逼自己到极限,怎么跟那些醒着都在学习的人竞争?
options.feedback: 被同伴压力裹挟,继续透支自己,只会重蹈失败的覆辙。

options.text: Maybe I am just not talented enough, so there is no strategy that can save me.
options.textCn: 也许我就是没天赋,再好的策略也救不了我。
options.feedback: 陷入自我否定,备考策略首先需要信心作为前提。

n4.speaker: 研友 Zhao Lin
n4.line: This plan sounds much more workable than what I had before, but one thing still worries me: what should I do in the final month, when revision pressure is at its highest?
n4.lineCn: 这个计划比我以前的靠谱多了,但我还有一件事担心:最后一个月复习压力最大的时候该怎么办?

grammar.name: what 宾语从句 + when 定语从句修饰时间
grammar.note: what I had before 作比较对象,when revision pressure is at its highest 是定语从句修饰 month,冒号引出具体问题。

options.text: In the final month, we switch to mock exams under real timing every three days, review only high-frequency error patterns, and keep the daily load light enough to protect your sleep and confidence.
options.textCn: 最后一个月改成每三天一次限时模拟考,只复盘高频错题类型,日常任务减到不牺牲睡眠和信心的程度。
options.feedback: 为冲刺期设计了明确但克制的方案,兼顾实战演练与状态保护,策略完整闭环。

options.text: In the final month, you should do ten mock exams every day, because more questions always means better preparation.
options.textCn: 最后一个月每天做十套模拟卷,题做得越多准备就越充分。
options.feedback: 数量迷信,忽略疲劳与消化,冲刺期这样做大概率临场崩盘。

options.text: I think I will just stop studying in the final month, so that I am completely fresh on exam day.
options.textCn: 最后一个月我干脆不学了,这样考试当天精神饱满。
options.feedback: 突然完全停摆会让手感生疏,冲刺期应该减量而非归零。

success.speaker: 研友 Zhao Lin
success.line: That makes a complete strategy: baseline diagnosis, progressive reading training, weekly review, and a controlled final-month sprint. I feel confident now, and I will share this plan with you every Sunday.
success.lineCn: 这构成一个完整的策略:基线诊断、渐进阅读训练、每周复盘、克制的冲刺。我现在有信心了,每周日我会跟你同步计划执行情况。

fail1.speaker: 研友 Zhao Lin
fail1.line: I am afraid that strategy will only lead me back to the same burnout I experienced before, so let us not repeat that mistake.
fail1.lineCn: 恐怕那个策略只会让我重蹈之前的崩溃,我们还是别重复那个错误了。

fail2.speaker: 研友 Zhao Lin
fail2.line: If that is how you want to plan, I cannot support you in it, but I hope you will reconsider before it is too late.
fail2.lineCn: 如果你坚持这样规划,我无法支持,但我希望你在为时已晚之前重新考虑。
